evidence.abort_reason: search endpoint failed on all of the last 3 ticks

summary: A kill fault on the things-search service resulted in a total service outage with a 100% error rate, ultimately failing to recover within the allotted time and triggering a recovery timeout.

root_cause_hypotheses.hypothesis: The things-search service failed to successfully restart or re-initialize its search endpoint after the process was killed.
root_cause_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: The during_search_error_rate reached 1.0 and the recovery_outcome was 'timeout'.

findings.evidence: The during_search_error_rate increased from 0.0 to 1.0, and the experiment aborted because the search endpoint failed on all of the last 3 ticks.
findings.recommended_fix: Review the liveness and readiness probe configurations for things-search to ensure the orchestrator can correctly identify and recover failed instances.
findings.title: Total Search Service Outage
findings.impact: Users were completely unable to perform search operations during the fault period.

findings.evidence: The experiment state reached RECOVERY_TIMEOUT and recovery_outcome was 'timeout'.
findings.recommended_fix: Investigate the startup latency and dependency initialization (mongodb, things) for the things-search service to identify bottlenecks in the recovery path.
findings.title: Recovery Timeout
findings.impact: The system did not return to a healthy state automatically within the expected timeframe, requiring manual intervention or rollback.

recommended_next_experiment: Execute a controlled restart of the things-search service while monitoring connection pool initialization to MongoDB and the Things service to pinpoint why recovery exceeded the timeout.
